doc_title: TRANSFER PURSUANT TO PURCHASE BY CHARGEE WITH LEAVE OF COURT
doc_title_official: TRANSFER PURSUANT TO PURCHASE BY CHARGEE WITH LEAVE OF COURT
when_used: A chargee exercising its power of sale buys the charged land itself with the leave of the court, and transfers the title to itself.

detail_rows.label: Charge(s) Registered in the Register as Entry Number(s):
Chargee (as Transferor): Give full name(s) and if corporate the registered number, if any
Transferee (being the Chargee): Give full name(s) and company’s registered number, if any
Chargor: Give full name(s) and company’s registered number, if any

body_text.text: The Chargee in exercise of its power of sale and with the leave of the Court HEREBY TRANSFERS to the Transferee (being the Chargee) the interest comprised in the above Title;
The Transfer is subject to the following:
The provisions of The Land Registration Act and The Land Act;
The interests noted in the Register of the Title; BUT otherwise free of the Charge(s)
The Transfer is also subject to the following additional provisions, if any:
The Transferee(s) shall hold the land comprised in the Title as joint proprietors/as proprietors in common*** in the following undivided shares:-
IN WITNESS the Chargee (as Transferor) and the Transferee (being the Chargee) have signed this Transfer as a deed.

execution.signed_label: SIGNED AND SEALED by the duly authorised attorneys of the
execution.verification_heading: Verification of execution pursuant to Section 45 of the Land Registration Act
execution.signing_recital: under and by virtue of Powers of Attorney registered at the {{poa_lands_registry}} Lands registry as number {{poa_lands_no_1}} and {{poa_lands_no_2}} and at the registry of Documents at Nairobi as Number {{poa_docs_no_1}} and {{poa_docs_no_2}} respectively

foot_notes: **The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”
